Database.//: On a laboratory LAN, point this at the server's SQL Server Express instance.

Application.//: Language the login screen opens in; each user's own preference applies after sign-in.
Application.//SeedDemoDataOnFirstRun: Demonstration/training data (DEMO- patients, demo.* users). MUST be false on any production installation - see DemoDataSeeder.

OrderRegistration.//: Ten years is the Moroccan minimum for a medical record; a laboratory may keep longer.

Reporting.//: See src/MarocLIS.Reporting/LICENSING.md before setting this to Community.

Labels.//: Windows name of the label printer, exactly as in Devices and Printers. Leave empty and labels come out as a PDF for the operator's viewer instead - which prints to the default printer, so set this on any workstation that has a label printer.

Instruments.//: Set false on workstations that must not drive analysers; only one host should.
Instruments.//ServiceAccount: Non-interactive account analyser results are attributed to. Seeded on first run; the host refuses to start without it rather than borrowing a signed-in operator's name.
